name: Hospital corridor
desc: Waiting, bad news, running; a place that is always between the rooms where things happen.
tags: hospital corridor, long hallway, pale vinyl floor with reflections, handrail along the wall, fluorescent ceiling panels, empty gurney against the wall, wheeled IV stand, numbered doors receding, wire glass window in a door, ceiling signage, row of plastic chairs
prose: a long hospital corridor with pale vinyl flooring and a handrail running the wall, banks of fluorescent panels overhead, numbered doors receding to a vanishing point and an empty gurney parked to one side
note: A corridor only reads as a corridor if it has somewhere to GO - name the receding doors and the far end, or you get one wall photographed head on. The gurney and the IV stand are what say hospital instead of office; drop them and it turns into a school. Sterile and clinical are not renderable: the brightness and the flat cold cast belong to the hospital look, which was built for exactly this room.
